definitions.explanation: The act or state of eating more than is good for one's health or comfort. Used both for a single occasion (eating too much at one meal) and a habitual pattern.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎで⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful not to overeat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{過|す}ぎ→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体重|たいじゅう}→体重：03395_taijuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Over the New Year holidays, I gained weight from overeating and drinking too much.

notes:
Noun form of {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎる (to overeat), formed with the ます-stem + {過|す}ぎ. The same pattern works with many other verbs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to watch out for overeating
- {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎで⟦{太|ふと}る→太る：01190_futoru⟧: to put on weight from overeating
- {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{過|す}ぎ→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: overeating and overdrinking

SIMILAR PATTERN:
- ⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{過|す}ぎ→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: drinking too much
- ⟦{寝|ね}→寝る：00470_neru⟧{過|す}ぎ: oversleeping
- ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{過|す}ぎ: overuse
- ⟦{働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎ→働き過ぎ：28202_hatarakisugi⟧: overwork
